Aster Technologies Pvt. Ltd..note: Aster Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an independent commercial kitchen and foodservice equipment manufacturer based in India and has not been acquired.

Dharam Industries.note: Dharam Industries is an active manufacturer of commercial kitchen equipment, including soft-serve ice cream machines, operating independently out of Ghaziabad, India, with no recorded history of acquisition.

Frigomat.note: In January 2025, the founding Cipeletti family bought out the remaining 50% stake in Frigomat from the Soffientini family to take 100% full ownership of the company.

Huasheng.note: Huasheng (Huasheng Group) continues to operate independently as a Chinese commercial refrigeration manufacturer, with no verifiable record of a corporate acquisition or majority-stake purchase.

Jiangmen City Xinhui District Mayhope Ma.note: The company operates as an independent manufacturer in Guangdong, China, and there is no record of an acquisition.

Kuhltec Pty Ltd.note: The company is an Australian owned and operated manufacturer and supplier of commercial soft serve machines and remains independent.

Niknam Industrial Group.note: Niknam Industrial Group remains an active, independent family-owned manufacturer of soft serve ice cream machines operating primarily in Iran.

QFrozen.note: QFrozen operates as an independent brand of Italia S.r.l. manufacturing professional soft serve and frozen yogurt equipment.

Shanti Engineers.note: Shanti Engineers is a sole proprietorship manufacturing and trading commercial kitchen equipment under the Pacific Soda Shop brand.

Stoelting Foodservice.note: The Vollrath Company acquired Polar Ware Company, including its Stoelting operation, in May 2012.

Trufrost Cooling Pvt. Ltd..note: Trufrost Cooling Pvt. Ltd. operates independently as a commercial refrigeration and foodservice equipment provider in India.

Yinshuo Zhizao Refrigeration Technology.note: Yinshuo Zhizao Refrigeration Technology operates as an independent refrigeration equipment manufacturer founded in 2014.
